name: <agent-name>
owner: <team or person accountable for this agent>
job: <one sentence: the single job this agent does>

trigger.event: <the thing that happens: new job created, document returned, PR opened>

_scheduled_alternative.note: Use type=schedule for timer-driven agents (hourly, daily, weekly). Recurring deployments can run on the CI system that already handles repo access, secrets, and billing.

model._policy: Small fast model for high-volume, fast tasks; larger model only where deeper reasoning justifies the cost. Swapping models is a one-line change.

scopes: <least privilege for this agent's single job>

human_in_the_loop._modes: recommend | automate — start at recommend; move to automate only after the agent matches or beats humans on this task in evals
human_in_the_loop.surface: <job banner for in-flow review, or chat channel for thread review>

value_reporting.warehouse_table: <table where this agent reports its own value per run>
